import heapq

def main():
    N = int(input().strip())
    A = list(map(int, input().strip().split()))
    B = list(map(int, input().strip().split()))
    X = list(map(int, input().strip().split()))

    dist = [float('inf')] * (N + 1)
    dist[1] = 0
    q = [(0, 1)]
    heapq.heapify(q)

    while q:
        current_time, v = heapq.heappop(q)
        if current_time > dist[v]:
            continue

        if v < N:
            # Action A: Move to stage v+1
            if dist[v + 1] > dist[v] + A[v - 1]:
                dist[v + 1] = dist[v] + A[v - 1]
                heapq.heappush(q, (dist[v + 1], v + 1))

            # Action B: Move to stage X[v-1]
            if dist[X[v - 1]] > dist[v] + B[v - 1]:
                dist[X[v - 1]] = dist[v] + B[v - 1]
                heapq.heappush(q, (dist[X[v - 1]], X[v - 1]))

    print(dist[N])
